SELECT
FROM course_comments cc JOIN users u ON u.id = cc.user_id LEFT JOIN course_comments parent ON parent.id = cc.parent_comment_id LEFT JOIN course_comments reply_target ON reply_target.id = cc.reply_to_comment_id AND reply_target.course_id = cc.course_id LEFT JOIN users reply_target_user ON reply_target_user.id = reply_target.user_id WHERE cc.course_id = #{courseId} AND ( ( cc.parent_comment_id IS NULL AND ( cc.deleted = 0 OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM course_comments reply WHERE reply.parent_comment_id = cc.id AND reply.course_id = cc.course_id AND reply.deleted = 0 ) ) ) OR ( cc.parent_comment_id IS NOT NULL AND cc.deleted = 0 AND parent.id IS NOT NULL AND parent.course_id = cc.course_id AND parent.parent_comment_id IS NULL ) ) ORDER BY CASE WHEN cc.parent_comment_id IS NULL THEN cc.create_at ELSE parent.create_at END ASC, CASE WHEN cc.parent_comment_id IS NULL THEN cc.id ELSE parent.id END ASC, CASE WHEN cc.parent_comment_id IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END ASC, cc.create_at ASC, cc.id ASC

SELECT id, parent_comment_id AS parentCommentId, reply_to_comment_id AS replyToCommentId, content, create_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt, deleted_at AS deletedAt, deleted, user_id AS userId, course_id AS courseId FROM course_comments WHERE id = #{commentId} AND deleted = 0
